project.name: Cannabinoid Molecular Atlas — Pilot Zero
project.description: Synthetic offline fixture for validating evidence gates. No real sample was measured.

candidates.label: Cannabidiol (CBD) reference hypothesis
candidates.hypothesis: A shared precursor-mass signal might be consistent with CBD, but cannot establish identity.

candidates.label: Delta-9-THC reference hypothesis
candidates.hypothesis: An isomeric candidate might explain the same precursor signal.

candidates.label: Unassigned synthetic signal
candidates.hypothesis: An unmatched signal would require more evidence before a compound assignment is possible.

evidence.statement: Invented signal in a teaching fixture; expected value is not a measured identification.
Same fictional precursor used deliberately to show that exact mass cannot distinguish THC from CBD.
An intentionally incorrect candidate match used to test mass-tolerance rejection.
